scope: Remove the miscellaneous tools page from the daily setting flow; keep research outside daily navigation.

implementation.library: Direct thumbnails, one family filter, natural page scrolling
implementation.research: Mounted only for ?research=1; no normal navigation or reference links
implementation.checks: Geometry and static-support notices retained; one action locates an infeasible support state

browser_validation.method: Manual interaction through the Codex in-app browser; DOM and visual inspection
browser_validation.menu: Exactly two actions; Escape restores summary focus; outside click and Tab out close it
browser_validation.library: 18 holds; Pocket filter leaves O1; selecting it opens matching wall editor with focus; selecting F10 at library bottom scrolls to top
browser_validation.moving_to_library: Opening library exits move mode; selecting another hold opens its editor
browser_validation.edit: Rotate F10 +15 degrees; revision 2; stale check status; no daily comparison overlay
browser_validation.support: Click support issue action jumps to event 2/13 release posture; current static-support warning displayed
browser_validation.research: Explicit URL opens research; profile changes to basic and generator remains enabled; scan workspace mounted; return to / removes research from DOM

checks.note: Existing large JS chunk warning remains.

limitations: Physics and fatigue remain approximate; this change does not improve route quality.
Research code still ships in the existing frontend bundle; its DOM and scan tools are not mounted in daily mode.
